Seven years ago our favourite jank-cooling duo set off on a quest to build the PC of Linus' dreams. But those dreams were swiftly crushed due to missing parts, a water cooling company having troubles, and our famed Alex Clark leaving to do his own thing. But that was seven years ago, and in the year 2026 we finally made it happen.

Thanks to Alex and Andy from Zip Tie Tuning & Zip Tie Tech for helping out. Check their channels out at:
https://www.youtube.com/@UCWqW23Ko6dbscptZYyQE-8A 
https://www.youtube.com/@UCUpt_5O1vYpWAGg77iNMQXA 

Thanks to EKWB for custom making the CPU and GPU blocks for us. Check them out at: https://www.ekwb.com/

Discuss on the forum: https://linustechtips.com/topic/1643453-finishing-what-we-started-seven-years-ago/

✔️ UPSC ko exam nahi, process of transformation samajhte hain

🧠 UPSC mindset & thinking-based content

📚 Classroom insights & teacher wisdom
🔥 Motivation jo soch badle, sirf excite nahi kare
